verdict.rationale: Anytype's own infrastructure syncs and backs up data automatically across its desktop and mobile apps, and the docs state that not even Anytype can see your content. A hands-on user reports that cross-device sync worked great, and a third party describes the model as E2E-encrypted protocols. missing for 10: in-depth technical documentation of the sync encryption and key handling, or an independent audit verifying the vendor cannot read synced data.
